'''Foothill''' was an underground cavern on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Toprawa/Legends|Toprawa]] that was used as a base by the [[Antarian Rangers/Legends|Antarian Rangers]] and other Toprawan rebels during the early [[Standard year/Legends|years]] of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]]. The base was connected to the resistance facility [[Mountain Home]] via a series of subterranean tunnels.
